_source: Static pitch-proposal form config (formerly the non-account fields of the dropped fixture). copy/sample verbatim from decentraland/governance-ui intl/en.json page.submit_pitch.* and newProposalPitchScheme; submissionThresholdVp from decentraland/governance SUBMISSION_THRESHOLD_PITCH (GATSBY_SUBMISSION_THRESHOLD_PITCH, defaults to 100). This is NOT a Catalyst read — governance runs on Snapshot + Aragon externally and exposes NO createProposal write reachable from this app, so the final submission is SIMULATED, and VP scoring has no catalyrst endpoint (a connected wallet is treated eligible client-side).

sample.problem_statement: Decentraland is desktop-first and there is no first-party way for community members to stay connected to events, governance and friends while away from their PC. New users who hear about an event have no lightweight way to RSVP, get reminders or jump in quickly, so we lose engagement between sessions.
sample.proposed_solution: Fund a small external team to ship a read-first mobile companion: an events feed with RSVP and reminders, a governance feed with proposal summaries and delegate-aware vote nudges, and friend presence. It would reuse the existing Catalyst and events APIs, so no new on-chain surface is required for v1.
sample.target_audience: Active Decentraland community members and DAO voters who already attend events and follow governance but currently miss timely updates when they are away from their desktop client. Secondary audience: curious newcomers who heard about an event and want a low-friction way to engage before installing the full client.
sample.relevance: Mobile engagement is where competing virtual-world and social platforms capture attention between sessions, and the DAO has repeatedly flagged retention as a priority. Shipping a focused companion now — ahead of the next events season — keeps the community engaged across devices and creates a foundation a future Tender can extend with deeper features.
